svg.title: Recognition
svg.desc: Every year: Top performance rating, VNG "A: Excellent" 2024–26, top at Lazada; 2025: Sao Khuê Award, Fintech, Zalopay pay on delivery; 2024 · 2025: Zalopay Hackathon, Champion, twice; 2026: Zalopay AI Exhibition, Top 5 product team; 2026: Zalopay Security Contest, 3rd place; 2023: Lazada, Best Employee Award
